newsitem.title: FRANCE: LAGARDERE SHARES TURN UP ON SALES RISE.
newsitem.headline: LAGARDERE SHARES TURN UP ON SALES RISE.

text.p: French missiles to publishing conglomerate Lagardere edged into positive territory in share trading on Monday after ceding ground initially following release of first-half turnover figures up 18.4 percent.
At 1015 GMT, shares were up 0.17 percent at 173.8 francs in volume of 55,618 shares after slipping to 171 francs earlier. The share outperformed the overall CAC-40 index which was down 0.49 percent.
First half turnover totalled 30.5 billion francs.
It was up 12.8 percent on a like-for-like basis.

"The figures were completely in line with our expectations," said one analyst. "One thing to note is the strength of its automobile and transport division, helped by sales of the new Espace," he said.
Lagardere makes the Espace minivan for Renault SA
Sales of the automobile and transport division rose to 3.47 billion francs from 2.02 billion in the corresponding year earlier period.
